name: Extensions
description: Run extensions from the Chrome Web Store

name: Remote debugging port
description: Let DevTools clients connect on this port

name: Chromium features
description: Chromium features to turn on, separated by commas

name: Show window regions
description: Outline every area the window manager tracks: window buttons, drag, shell, pages and the settings page

name: Show the welcome at each start
description: Open the welcome over the whole window at every start, as on a first start

name: Settings layout
description: How this page is laid out: page, every setting on one page by task (the default), or sections, one section at a time from a list. Applies at once
